data.name: Khidash
data.gender_notes: Khidash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-d-sh', meaning 'to go before', 'to conduct', or 'to guide'. In Islamic tradition, Khidash is often used to refer to angels or spiritual guides who help and protect humans. The name Khidash carries the meaning “Guide, Conduit, Escort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khidash usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, conduit, escort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine guidance and protection
data.etymology: Khidash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Conduit, Escort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khidash total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: خِداش

in_urdu.name: خِداش

In another reference, Al-Maqrizi mentions a man named Khidash who was the founder of the Burjid Dynasty in Iraq in the late 12th century. He seized power in 1195 and ruled until his death in 1203.
